<?php
class Payload194 { public function __construct(public string $tag) {} public function __destruct() { echo 'PAY-', $this->tag, ';'; } }
function shift194() { global $owner, $payload; $owner = null; $payload = new Payload194('NEW'); echo 'SHIFT;'; return 9; }
class Base194 { private static function secret() { return 'PRIVATE'; } public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) { echo $name, '|', $arguments['first']->tag, '|', $arguments['later'], '|', self::secret(), '|', self::class, '|', static::class, '|', __METHOD__, ';'; $child = new class($arguments) { public function __construct(public array $saved) {} public function __destruct() { echo 'CHILD;'; } }; unset($arguments); $child->saved = []; echo 'BUFFER;'; return $child; } public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; } }
class Derived194 extends Base194 {}
$owner = new Derived194; $payload = new Payload194('OLD'); $child = $owner->MiSsInG(first: $payload, later: shift194()); echo 'RETURN;'; unset($payload); echo 'HELD;', $child->saved === [], ';'; unset($child); echo 'AFTER;';
